name: Amiga 1200
credits: Layout after the Amiga 1200 (1992) US keyboard; colours after its white case, low-profile white caps and light grey modifiers.
notes: Faithful: the same arrangement as the A500 (Esc and the function keys on top, Del and Help above the inverted-T cursor keys, the L-shaped Return, Ctrl beside Caps Lock, an Amiga key either side of the space bar, shifted legends above the characters), with the A1200's whiter case, flatter low-profile caps and lighter grey modifiers. Width: the numeric keypad is dropped, as on the A500 skin, so the keys stay legible on a 393 pt phone. Approximated: widths are compressed to fit a phone; the Return is two keys; the right Shift is a unit wider so the up arrow sits over the down arrow; and the Amiga keys are the text A (no logo). Mapped to none: F1 to F10, Del, Help, Tab, Ctrl, both Alt keys and both Amiga keys.
